name: waymakerlabs-claude-plugins
description: A collection of useful Claude Code plugins by WaymakerLabs

plugins.name: minimal-statusline
plugins.description: Minimal single-line statusline with Nord Aurora theme

plugins.name: wrap-up
plugins.description: Session wrap-up skill - Obsidian documentation + Git commit in one go. Auto-generate daily log and handoff docs with explicit parallel-delegation next-steps, with a pre-commit verification gate that follows the project/global cross-check setup (e.g. direct codex CLI run) when configured

plugins.name: obsidian-documents
plugins.description: Save to Obsidian - Auto-save content to Obsidian vault as markdown when asked

plugins.name: claude-organizer
plugins.description: Organize CLAUDE.md into a modular, skill-based project structure with Progressive Disclosure

plugins.name: verify-skills
plugins.description: Self-maintaining code verification framework - auto-generate and run project-specific verify skills

plugins.name: minimal-statusline-zai
plugins.description: Minimal single-line statusline for z.ai API with Nord Aurora theme

plugins.name: plan-and-build
plugins.description: Structured workflow: Research → Plan → Annotation Cycle → Implementation

plugins.name: math-exam
plugins.description: 수학 시험지/문제지 PDF 생성 - 중1~고3 학력평가/수능 형식, 한컴 수식 → LaTeX 자동 변환

plugins.name: linear
plugins.description: Linear issue management, dev cycle automation, and planning workflows

plugins.name: llm-wiki
plugins.description: LLM Wiki intake + recall + classify integrated helper. /llm-wiki:capture (external URL/memo → 00. Inbox intake with security redaction + 4-stage dedupe) + /llm-wiki:search (read-only 4-layer recall) + /llm-wiki:classify (inbox auto-classification, dry-run/live). Designed for Telegram(openclaw) adapter + home-macmini schedule.

plugins.name: focused-analysis
plugins.description: Dual independent-track cross-verification for hard diagnostic questions — an Opus subagent and codex CLI run in parallel on the same question, then Claude synthesizes agreement/disagreement into one final judgment. Triggered by '집중 분석해줘'/'상세 분석해줘'. Requires the Codex CLI (installed and authenticated).

plugins.name: auto-chain
plugins.description: Milestone → wave → task autonomous execution for large multi-session work. Opus plans, GPT-6.1 Sol reviews (codex CLI via a common review runner), Claude workers implement in parallel, and a lean coordinator session per milestone integrates, verifies and hands off to the next milestone. Workers run in three tiers: Claude Agent subagents by default, headless one-shot runs for other CLIs and reviews, and side-pane sessions (via the tool-neutral agent-orchestrator in tools/) only for watched work, planners that outlive a handoff, and milestone handoffs. Per-project hooks via .claude/autonomous-chain.md. Requires the Codex CLI for reviews; side panes need agent-orchestrator and a supported tool.

plugins.name: helpai
plugins.description: Project helper skill set (helpai namespace). project-setup bootstraps a folder: private GitHub repo via gh, a fixed docs/ layout with docs/index.md as the single document index, a milestone ledger (M{plan}-{nn} IDs), and idempotent docs rules in the project CLAUDE.md.

plugins.name: review-chain
plugins.description: QC follow-up chain: one OC session takes the user's QC findings into a queue, spawns worker sessions (one per discussion-type feature, one bundled worker for small non-overlapping fixes) in their own git worktrees, checks file-scope conflicts before work starts, serializes merges, and owns shared files (version, release notes, progress ledger, external trackers). The user talks to workers directly in their tabs/panes; workers report to whichever OC is current via an indirection file, so the OC can be replaced when its context fills. Uses the tool-neutral agent-orchestrator in tools/.

plugins.name: inbox-hooks
plugins.description: review-chain·auto-chain이 쓰는 받은편지함 훅(단독 사용 안 함). Inbox hooks used by review-chain and auto-chain (not for standalone use): asyncRewake waiters wake an idle session when a subscribed agent-orchestrator inbox gets a line. Disabled by default; enabled only as a dependency.
